hero.tagline: I craft digital experiences that connect, inspire, and solve real problems through design.

about.title: About me
about.intro: I'm a passionate UX/UI designer with 5+ years of experience creating digital experiences that make a difference. My approach combines deep user research with impactful visual design and emotional storytelling.

story.title: My Story
story.p1: My journey in UX design began 5 years ago when I realized that the most powerful technology is the one people can intuitively use. Since then, I've worked with startups and established companies to create digital products that truly matter.
story.p2: My approach is based on deep user research, constant iteration, and close collaboration with development teams. I believe the best design is invisible: it works so well that users don't even notice it.
story.p3: When I'm not designing, you'll find me exploring new UX methodologies, reading about behavioral psychology, or experimenting with new prototyping tools.

userCentric.title: User-Centered
userCentric.desc: Every design decision is based on real user needs.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.desc: I constantly seek new ways to solve complex problems.

goalOriented.title: Goal-Oriented
goalOriented.desc: I design with purpose, always aligned with business goals.

rapidIteration.title: Rapid Iteration
rapidIteration.desc: I prototype quickly, test early, and improve continuously.

portfolio.title: My Portfolio
portfolio.intro: Here you'll find some of my featured projects, from mobile apps to complex web platforms. Each project tells a unique story of innovation and user-centered design.

ecobank.title: EcoBank - Banking App
ecobank.description: Complete redesign of a mobile banking app focused on sustainability and user experience.

healthcare.description: Dashboard for healthcare professionals to efficiently manage patients and appointments.

foodieshare.title: FoodieShare - Social Platform
foodieshare.description: Social platform for food lovers to share recipes and culinary experiences.

edulearn.title: EduLearn - E-learning Platform
edulearn.description: Online learning platform focused on gamification and student engagement.

contact.intro: Do you have a project in mind? I'd love to learn more about your idea and how I can help you create an exceptional experience that impacts your users.
